info.name: Community Waste Collection API
info.description: Household, pickup, billing and payment confirmation checkpoint. Run from repository root with Docker Compose active. Upload fixtures are under postman/fixtures. Dedicated historical fixtures/proofs remain; existing records are preserved. Reports, seed and public docs follow later.

request.description: Checks PostgreSQL connectivity. Returns 200 while available and 503 with a generic error when unavailable.
Unknown paths return a JSON error.
The health endpoint accepts GET and HEAD only.

item.name: Households
item.description: Run this folder in order. Four endpoints with positive and negative cases. It creates and removes its own household.

request.description: Required nonblank owner_name and address. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed. Stores the generated UUID for subsequent requests.

exec: pm.test('Fields and timestamps', function () { pm.expect(household.owner_name).to.eql('Ayu'); pm.expect(household.address).to.eql('Jl. Merdeka 1'); pm.expect(household.created_at).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(household.updated_at).to.eql(household.created_at); });

request.description: Read the record created by the first request.

exec: pm.test('Stored household', function () { const household = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(household.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('household_id')); pm.expect(household.owner_name).to.eql('Ayu'); pm.expect(household.address).to.eql('Jl. Merdeka 1'); });

request.description: Required fields are validated after trimming whitespace.

originalRequest.description: Required fields are validated after trimming whitespace.

request.description: Broken JSON is rejected before service validation.
PostgreSQL TEXT does not accept NUL. Invalid field values are rejected before persistence.
Vertical tab is not valid JSON whitespace and must not be silently removed.
Only owner_name and address may be supplied. IDs are generated by the server.
IDs must contain hexadecimal UUID text in 8-4-4-4-12 format.
The maximum page size is 100.
JSON requests require Content-Type application/json.
JSON request bodies are limited to 64 KiB. The local variable is generated only for this request.
Deletes only the record created by this folder. A household with related pickup/payment records returns 409 household_in_use.
A valid UUID that no longer exists returns 404.
Repeated deletion returns 404 and does not affect other records.

item.name: Pickups
item.description: Run in order. Creates one dedicated household and two pickups; cancels both at the end. These records remain as history because pickups cannot be deleted. No existing data is changed. Billing policies are exercised by the Billing folder and isolated PostgreSQL tests.

request.description: Creates a new household for this run. Retained with pickup history.

request.description: Creates a pending pickup with no scheduled date.

exec: pm.test('Initial pickup', function () { const p = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(p.status).to.eql('pending'); pm.expect(p.type).to.eql('organic'); pm.expect(p.household_id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('pickup_household_id')); pm.expect(p.pickup_date).to.eql(null); pm.expect(p.safety_check).to.eql(null); });

item.description: Run in order. Creates a dedicated household and three pickups before issuing invoices. Completed pickups and invoices are retained, including pending invoices, so only this fixture household remains blocked. Does not change existing data. Confirmation/date filters are covered in the next folder.

request.description: Pickup already has a payment
Household has a pending payment
Pending invoices do not block scheduling of an existing pickup.

Completion keeps the invoice ID and never duplicates it.

exec: pm.test('Exactly one original invoice', function () { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.meta.total).to.eql(1); pm.expect(b.data).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(b.data[0].id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('billing_payment_id')); pm.expect(b.data[0].amount).to.eql('100000.00'); });

item.name: Verify automatic tariff and invoice count

request.description: Lists manual and automatic invoices with exact decimal strings.

exec: pm.test('Two invoices with exact tariffs', function () { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.meta.total).to.eql(2); pm.expect(b.data).to.have.lengthOf(2); const organic = b.data.find(function (p) { return p.waste_id === pm.collectionVariables.get('billing_organic_id'); }); const electronic = b.data.find(function (p) { return p.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('billing_payment_id'); }); pm.expect(organic.amount).to.eql('50000.00'); pm.expect(electronic.amount).to.eql('100000.00'); });

item.name: Confirmation
item.description: Creates dedicated fixtures. Completes a pickup, confirms with a PDF, verifies date boundaries and permits a new pickup after payment. Also verifies failed/repeated confirmation. Stored proof and paid/failed history are retained. Set Postman working directory to repository root.

exec: pm.test('Automatic invoice available', function () { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.meta.total).to.eql(1); pm.expect(b.data[0].amount).to.eql('50000.00'); });

request.description: Only pending payment can be confirmed
Input validation failed
Proof file must contain JPEG, PNG, or PDF content

response.name: Unsupported Media Type

request.description: Exactly one proof_file. JPEG/PNG/PDF content signature, <=5 MiB. Sets paid/payment_date/path; repeated confirmation conflicts.

exec: pm.test('Paid with local proof', function () { const p = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(p.status).to.eql('paid'); pm.expect(p.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('confirm_payment_id')); pm.expect(p.payment_date).to.match(/Z$/); pm.expect(p.proof_file_url).to.match(/^uploads\/[0-9a-f-]{36}\.pdf$/); });

if (pm.response.code === 200) { const parts = pm.response.json().data.payment_date.slice(0, -1).split('.'); const nanos = Number((parts[1] || '').padEnd(9, '0')) + 1; pm.collectionVariables.set('confirm_after_date', parts[0] + '.' + String(nanos).padStart(9, '0') + 'Z'); }

request.description: Only pending payment can be confirmed

request.description: Inclusive beginning, filters payment_date; preserves timestamp precision.

exec: pm.test('Inclusive lower bound and original proof', function () { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.meta.total).to.eql(1); pm.expect(b.data).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(b.data[0].payment_date).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('confirm_date')); pm.expect(b.data[0].proof_file_url).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('confirm_proof')); });

request.description: Exclusive ending; failed invoice with NULL payment_date is also excluded.

exec: pm.test('Exclusive upper bound excludes payment', function () { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.meta.total).to.eql(0); pm.expect(b.data).to.deep.eql([]); });
